events.title: Patchnote 1.01
events.summary: Hey everyone! First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who downloaded and played the demo! Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and we’ve been hard at work fixing as much as we can. This first patch brings a big batch of improvements and fixes.Improved visibility of interactable itemsImproved inventory to include previously missing itemsFixed collision working improperly on some objects & itemsFixed certain places where player could go out of boundsAdded more detailed names & description

events.title: ⚠️ DUAT Demo — Known Issues & Upcoming Update
